title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（森合秀樹研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Moriai Hideki)
educationalGoal: The objective of this course is to develop a basic ability to design, manufacture, and make feasible proposals for aircraft design, the application of aeronautical engineering theory, and the evaluation of actual phenomena related to aircraft.
advice:
Specific project themes will be determined through discussion, and problems will be discovered and resolved according to these discussions. Themes can be broadly classified as follows.

(1) Experiments and CFD research on the theme of improving the performance of existing aerospace engines such as rocket engines and jet engines.

(2) Basic research on new technologies such as scramjet engines and detonation engines. Phenomenon elucidation and empirical research by experiments and CFD.

(3) Proposal of futuristic innovative space propulsion engine using laser, plasma, etc. Basic research on phenomenon elucidation and principle demonstration by experiment and CFD.
requiredKnowledge: As Design Project III is based on previous lectures, it is necessary to review the experiments and the exercises in the department of aeronautics courses.

activityGoals.body: Be able to define project themes and act on engineering design processes.
Be able to summarize in reports, and present and discuss the reports.
Be able to design, draft, manufacture (production), simulate, etc.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Explain the purpose of the project theme and the process, and achieve annual goals that are suitable for the purpose.
(2) Summarize as an interim report, and present and discuss the report. Summarize as a project report and present and discuss in a public presentation review meeting. The final results can be published as an academic paper and receive an external evaluation.
(3) Design and manufacture experimental equipment, and evaluate the performance of the product.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Specific project themes will be determined through discussion, and problems will be discovered and resolved according to these discussions. Themes can be broadly classified as follows.

(1) Experiments and CFD research on the theme of improving the performance of existing aerospace engines such as rocket engines and jet engines.

(2) Basic research on new technologies such as scramjet engines and detonation engines. Phenomenon elucidation and empirical research by experiments and CFD.

(3) Proposal of futuristic innovative space propulsion engine using laser, plasma, etc. Basic research on phenomenon elucidation and principle demonstration by experiment and CFD.
